title: Leader at AI Server System Integrator Expects Micron-Related Business to Grow 40%–45% in 2026 Amid Supply Constraints
expert: Head of memory sourcing and final purchasing decision-maker at an AI server system integrator (Micron ~30% of memory spend)
verdict: An AI server integrator's memory buyer is paying 55%–60% more y/y for Micron memory yet still bought about 18% more units in Sept–Nov 2026, with lead times out to 6 to 10 months and LTA coverage up to 85%–90%.
thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (supply short through 2028): ↑ — lead times 6 to 10 months vs 5 to 8; balance only late Q4 2027 or early Q1 2028.
Tenet 2 (AI demand outruns supply): ↑ — units +18% y/y despite 55%–60% higher prices; 15% supply-demand gap.
Tenet 3 (SCAs): ↑ — LTA coverage 85%–90% from 65%–70%; at least 75% of 2027 buys with down payments.
Tenet 4 (pricing durable, RoC peaked): ↑ — +15%–20% q/q, but the pace is moderating, consistent with RoC past peak.
Tenet 5 (HBM share): ↓ — SK hynix gaining some share from Micron and Samsung.
changes: Contract prices +15%–20% q/q (expert) vs Cleveland C4Q contract DRAM +15-20% q/q, MU ~+22% (SB #62062): consistent.
Lead times 6 to 10 months vs 5 to 8 months in Q2 (expert) vs TrendForce DRAM lead times 19 weeks and easing (SB #65604): **conflicting**.
LTA coverage 85%–90% vs 65%–70% 90 days earlier (expert) vs ex-Samsung SVP LTAs ~80-90% of server DRAM contracts (SB #62239): consistent.
Supply and demand balance late Q4 2027 or early Q1 2028 (expert) vs 2026-11-05 Rambus call relief Q3 2027 or Q4 2027: consistent, slightly later.

Spot vs contract DRAM pricing: 🟢 **Prices paid 55%–60% higher y/y and 15%–20% higher q/q**, in line with Cleveland's C4Q contract DRAM +15-20% q/q (SB #62062); pace moderating. → Tenet 4 (pricing durable) ↑
SCA coverage %: 🟢 **LTA coverage 85%–90% vs 65%–70% 90 days earlier**, consistent with LTAs at 80-90% of server DRAM contracts (SB #62239). → Tenet 3 (SCAs) ↑
🟢 **At least 75% of 2027 purchases to need down payments vs about half in 2026** (estimate), first read on prepayment share.
Supply & lead times: 🟢 **Lead times 6 to 10 months vs 5 to 8 months in Q2**; supply-demand gap 15%, backlog +5%–8%, vs TrendForce DRAM lead times easing to 19 weeks (SB #65604): **conflicting**. → Tenet 1 (supply short) ↑
🟢 **Units +18% y/y Sept–Nov**; expects Micron business +40%–45% in 2026 and about 35% in 2027 (estimate). → Tenet 2 (AI demand) ↑
HBM4E share + 2027 HBM pricing round: 🔴 **SK hynix gaining some share from Micron** on earlier launches; China-based suppliers already **7%–8%** of DRAM/NAND purchases. → Tenet 5 (HBM share) ↓
